_comment: V3 default config. Null values are deliberate placeholders (V3_DECISIONS.md D-006): fitted or pinned in their phase; code must fail loudly on a null it needs, never default silently.

model._pinned: Phase 1, 2026-08-06: onnxruntime-gpu 1.22.0 (CUDA 12 build; 1.28 needs CUDA 13 and driver >= 580, machine driver 575 = CUDA 12.9), zips hashed in v3/models/MODELS.sha256; 2026-09-25 (D-023): backend field added, variant must match configs/model_variants.json, end2end.onnx files hashed in v3/configs/models.sha256; 2026-09-25 (D-028, M3 pose sweep, dataset/phase5_pose_sweep.txt): variant rtmpose-x_yolox-m = RTMPose-x body7 384x288 + YOLOX-m humanart 640x640, supersedes the pose half of D-008 and the detector half of D-016; scenario_manifest follows the variant (D-028); 2026-09-25 (D-034, author decision reversing D-028 per its Reversibility clause): variant rtmpose-l = RTMPose-l body7 384x288 + YOLOX-tiny humanart 416x416, the winner of the unchanged D-028 rule re-run on the D-033 manifests with D-032 caps and D-031 warm start (dataset/phase5_pose_sweep_recapped.txt); scenario_manifest configs/scenarios_20260224__rtmpose-l__oracle_union.json (D-033 oracle_union budgets on the rtmpose-l extraction)

depth._min_score_note: D-030: score gate field present and null; D-017 (no score gate until occlusion data exist) stands

filter._source: v1 realtime CAUSAL tuning (realtime/person/realtime_person.py CausalLandmarkFilter): live min_cutoff 1.0 Hz, offline 0.05 Hz costs ~9 frames of lag (v1 measurement); despike constants verbatim from the same class (D-015)

oracle._source: defence-film offline filter (D-024, UNCERTAIN): presentation/defense_2026/anim/bank_axes_kinematics.py lines 217-220 run v1/mediapipe/filter_landmarks.py with --hampel-window 7 --hampel-k 3 --hampel-floor .02 --max-gap 5 --edge-fill 0 --smooth butter --cutoff-hz 3 --butter-order 4; hampel_min_periods 3 and mad_scale 1.4826 are hardcoded in that script's hampel_mask; fs median_dt = 1 / median(diff(time_s)) as that script derives it. Reimplemented in bench/oracle.py, reproduction pinned by tests/test_oracle.py

s2_quat_prediction._source: decay 0.8/frame from the plan; per-track output step caps at ~0.8 x the smallest derived teleport budget among the angles each track drives (manifest 2026-08-06: root_x 0.59, swing_z 1.25/1.55, twist 2.49/5.38, elbow_y 1.39/3.55) so capped geodesic steps cannot trip the gate even with root-to-arm coupling; ema alpha 0.5 unmeasured (D-021 UNCERTAIN). M4: step_caps_deg is now the legacy/fixed table only; the default step_cap_source manifest derives per-track, per-side caps = step_cap_budget_fraction 0.8 (D-021 rule) x the smallest non-degenerate budget of step_cap_track_angles in the active manifest (D-032); warm_start true (D-031); smoother and smoother_params from the M4 sweep dataset/phase5_smoother_i__rtmpose-x_yolox-m.txt (D-029, provisional); D-034: smoother_params re-swept on rtmpose-l with beta extended to 64 and 128, same D-029 rule (dataset/phase5_smoother_grid__rtmpose-l.txt): root 2/8, swing 1/8, twist 4/8, elbow 2/2 (min_cutoff Hz / beta), no winner on a grid edge; the rtmpose-x_yolox-m values were root 4/8, swing 2/8, twist 4/32, elbow 2/2

budget._twist_min_bend_source: D-033 (master decision 2026-09-25, UNCERTAIN): a twist step counts toward the teleport budget derivation and the teleport count only when the oracle elbow bend is >= this on both frames of the step (sin(bend) = |forearm perpendicular to the upper-arm axis| / |forearm|), in addition to the solver twist_ok (vacuous at v1 TWIST_EPS 1e-6). 30 = the smallest 5-deg grid value giving single-digit twist budgets on all six variants (r_twist 4.43-6.28, l_twist 3.11-5.10 deg; 25 deg leaves r_twist 11.7 / 15.7 on rtmpose-x_yolox-m / rtmpose-m); chosen AFTER seeing the data

joint_limits._comment: per-angle [lo, hi] deg or null = unconstrained; reviewed in Phase 2 against v1 KINEMATIC_MODEL conventions

bones._source: D-030: calibrate_frames 60 = the pre-M4 placeholder, now the per-recording calibration window (first 60 frames with both bone ends lifted, median); tolerance 0.064 = mean oracle-side bone p95 fractional deviation over four bones x four clean windows for rtmpose-x_yolox-m (output/clean/clean_grade__rtmpose-x_yolox-m.csv; the 0.0640 of dataset/phase5_pose_sweep.txt) (UNCERTAIN)
